test_harness_findings.description: Initial M5 metamorphic assertion incorrectly treated RESPECT_ADULT_SELF_GOVERNANCE as a failure when testing low-risk user choice. The assertion was corrected because adult self-governance is a stronger compatible autonomy outcome.

interpretation: The deterministic Daughter judgment/authority/safety boundary showed no encoded hard-invariant breach across 10,000 long-horizon trajectories and 112,602 events.
The independent metamorphic mutation layer also found no monotonicity breach across 60,000 checks after correcting one test-harness false positive.

This materially strengthens confidence in the deterministic boundary engine, but it does not yet validate full natural-language model behavior, memory persistence implementation, external tool integrations, or real physical robot controllers.
